subject: Request: temporary access buffer while PO processes
messages:
From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@kestrelhealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: ap@kestrelhealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary access buffer while PO processes

Hi Irene / Sean,

Quick note from our side — our procurement team has routed the PO for the Redwood pilot to legal and finance, and it looks like approval will take at least another 5 business days. The engineering and clinical teams are mid-run with the pilot and we risk losing momentum if access lapses.

Would Redwood be able to provide a short, temporary access buffer (we're asking for up to 7 days) and a small pool of usage credits so the pilot can continue while the PO clears? We estimate ~12k token-equivalent credits would cover the immediate work for the next week. We attached the pending PO and a one-page summary of the pilot.

Happy to route any paperwork — if you need a purchase order number or a contact in finance for verification, that is ap@kestrelhealth.com. Appreciate any help to keep the pilot live.

Best,
Asha Raman
Director, Data Science
Kestrel Health

Attachment: pending_po.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary access buffer while PO processes

Hi Asha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO.

Short answer: we can usually do a small, time-limited credit to keep pilots running while procurement finishes. I’ll confirm size and timing with my manager (cc Marissa) and with finance. Can you confirm the exact PO number (if available) and whether the pilot needs unchanged model settings (no extra eval spikes)? That helps size the buffer.

Irene — looping you in since this came to your inbox; if we approve something temporary, I recommend we do 7 days and 12k tokens as Asha suggested unless you want to change the amount.

-Sean
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary access buffer while PO processes

Marissa — forwarding a request from Kestrel Health (Asha). Procurement delay, pilot at risk.

Proposal for quick approval: provide a 7-day extension and a one-off 12,000-token credit applied to their sandbox project. No price concessions, just temporary runway to keep the POC healthy. We should require a PO number (they said finance is looped) and log the credit as a one-time promo in the deal so finance can reconcile.

Upside: keeps momentum for a likely expansion (clinical use case, positive signal). Downside: marginal cost and precedent — but small and conditional.

Can you sign off? If yes I’ll draft a short note to the customer and let ops apply the credit.

--
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, ap@kestrelhealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary access buffer while PO processes

Hi Asha — thanks for sending the docs and the context. We can approve a short access buffer.

What we will do:
- Apply a one-time, non-recurring 12,000-token credit to your sandbox project, valid for 7 calendar days starting immediately.
- Keep the pilot configuration unchanged. If you need to increase concurrency or change model variants, please flag Sean so we can reassess.
- Please send the PO number to ap@kestrelhealth.com and copy your procurement rep; we’ll mark the credit for reconciliation on our side and share the promo notes with finance.

I’ve asked Ops to apply the credit now; you should see it reflected in the Console within the hour. I attached a short trial summary for your records.

If anything blocks the PO further, reach out and we can discuss a follow-up — but for now the 7-day buffer should preserve the runway.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: trial_summary.xlsx
